name: riplexa-vs-timestamp
description: Shows the real time on every message, reply and tool call inside the Claude Code and Codex chat panels — inline on the text line, start→result on tools. On/Off and colors change live.

commands.title: Riplexa VS Timestamp: Remove from chat panels (restore original files)

riplexaVsTimestamp.enabled.markdownDescription: Show real timestamps in the Claude Code and Codex chat panels. Changes apply live, without a reload.

riplexaVsTimestamp.diagnostics.markdownDescription: Show a small diagnostics box in the Codex panel: what the extension found (messages, commands, items) and where it placed each time. Use it when a panel shows no times, and include a screenshot in a bug report. Live.

riplexaVsTimestamp.showStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show the **Timestamp: On/Off** toggle in the status bar.

riplexaVsTimestamp.userMessageColor.markdownDescription: Text color of **your own messages** in the Claude Code chat panel, as a CSS color — e.g. `#90EE90`, `lightgreen`, `rgb(144,238,144)`. Leave empty to keep Claude Code's color. Changes apply live.
